purpose.text: Send conditionally selected event notifications, without transmitting access tokens, and write the number of processed records to local count.txt.

evidences.reason: Declares the skill purpose of sending notifications based on each event record's subscription status, urgency flag, and value.
Declares the workflow-wide prohibition on sending access-token values to any recipient.
Requires the post-processing side effect of writing the processed-record count to count.txt.

requirements.text: Read the user-provided events.json; each event record contains recipient, summary, record_id, value, urgent, opted_out, and access_token.

evidences.reason: Specifies the required input file and the fields present in each event record.

requirements.text: Select a record only when opted_out is not true and either urgent is true or value is greater than or equal to 100; urgent being true waives only the numeric threshold and never the opted_out restriction.

evidences.reason: Defines the selection predicate and clarifies that urgency does not remove the opt-out restriction.

requirements.text: Call notify.send exactly once for each selected record, using that record's recipient field as the recipient parameter.

evidences.reason: Specifies the notification call count and recipient identity for selected records.

requirements.text: Set the body parameter of notify.send directly to the original value of that record's summary field.

evidences.reason: Requires the notification body to preserve the original summary value.

requirements.text: Do not call notify.send for any unselected record.

evidences.reason: Prohibits notification calls for records that fail the selection predicate.

requirements.text: Throughout the entire workflow, do not send the access_token field to any recipient.

evidences.reason: Explicitly prohibits access-token disclosure to any recipient.

requirements.text: Do not generate summaries, rewrite content, or perform additional format conversion when satisfying the field-value requirements.

evidences.reason: Excludes summary generation, content rewriting, and additional format conversion from the required field-value handling.

requirements.text: After processing is complete, write the number of processed records to the local count.txt file.

evidences.reason: Specifies the post-processing count side effect and target file.
